doc_name: 国务院关于煤炭行业化解过剩产能实现脱困发展的意见（国发〔2016〕7号）
quote_zh: 3年内原则上停止审批新建煤矿项目、新增产能的技术改造项目和产能核增项目
quote_en: For three years, in principle stop approving new coal mines, capacity-adding technical upgrades and capacity-raising projects.
notes: Target: exit about 500 Mt and restructure another 500 Mt in 3-5 years; 276 working-day capacity rule; close 13 types of small mines. Support side: 煤电一体化, 煤炭洗选加工转化, mechanisation, export policy, tax and loan support for core firms.

doc_name: 国务院关于煤炭行业化解过剩产能实现脱困发展的意见（国发〔2016〕7号）
quote_zh: 停止核准高硫高灰煤项目
quote_en: Stop approving high-sulphur, high-ash coal projects.
notes: Section 严格限制劣质煤使用: existing projects capped; stricter inspection of scattered low-grade coal sales in key regions.

doc_name: 国务院关于煤炭行业化解过剩产能实现脱困发展的意见（国发〔2016〕7号）
quote_en: Develop modern coal chemicals in an orderly way.
notes: Subject to environmental access conditions (试行).
